description:
List the integration types you can connect

Returns the catalogue of supported third-party services, each with the configuration fields it needs. Read this before creating an integration: `type` gives you the value to send, and `configFields` tells you exactly which keys belong inside the `config` JSON string and which of them are required. Fields declared with type `password` are masked when the integration is read back, and so is every other key that looks like a secret (see GET /integrations/{id}). The response is a bare JSON array and is the same for every account.
